name: workflow-section
title: Workflow Section
description: An interactive process section that lets visitors select a step and read its explanation in a paired detail panel. It accepts a title, optional introduction, ordered steps with stable ids, titles, descriptions, optional detail content, and a horizontal or vertical layout. Use it to explain how a service or product works when sequence matters; use a static feature list when steps are independent.

meta.engineeringNotes: Uses ordinary buttons to select one step and a separate detail region, rather than a custom carousel or a large timeline widget. This keeps every step discoverable, keyboard reachable, and usable without dragging or timed progression. Step content remains caller-authored, allowing product screenshots, simple text, or other local components without binding the block to a product domain.
meta.motionNotes: The active step changes without an animated slide; sequence and selection are conveyed by order, number, border, and text. This avoids implying that later steps are unavailable or that the visitor must wait for a timed transition. Reduced motion does not change the interaction or remove any content.

docs: Requires `cn` at `@/lib/utils`. Give each step a stable unique id and provide a detail node only when it adds useful context beyond the description.
